# Tobit Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Tobit 5 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/TOB_005_page_001.jpg

---

**5:1** And Tobias answered and said to-him, "Father, I will-do everything which you-have-commanded me.

**5:2** But how-shall-I be-able to-receive the-money from him, while he does-not know me, and I do-not know him? What sign shall-I give him, so-that he-may-recognize me and trust me and give me the-money? And I-do-not know the-roads of-Media, to-go there."

**5:3** And Tobit answered his-son Tobias, and said to-him, "The note-of-hand he-wrote, I-wrote; and I-split it in-two, and we-each took half; I put one-half with the-money. And behold, it-is twenty years since I-deposited this money. And now, child, seek for yourself a-trustworthy man who-will-travel with you, and we-shall-give him wages when we-return; and go bring back the-money from Gabael."

**5:4** And Tobias went to-seek a-man, and he-found Raphael who-was an-angel; and he-did-not know [it].

**5:5** And he-said to-him, "Can you-come with-me to-Rages of-Media? And do-you-know the-regions there?"

**5:6** And the-angel said to-him, "I-will-go with you, and the-regions I-know and I-have-stayed-the-night with Gabael our-brother."

**5:7** And Tobias said to-him, "Wait for-me, and I-will-tell my-father."

**5:8** And Raphael said, "Go, and do-not delay"; and he-went in and said to-his-father, "Behold, I-have-found a-man from our-brethren, of-the sons of-Israel."

And Tobit said, "Call him to-me, so-that I-may-know from what tribe he-is and whether he-is trustworthy to-go with you."

**5:9** And Tobias went out and called him and said, "Young-man, my-father calls you."

And he-went in to-him, and Tobit greeted him first; and Raphael said, "Much gladness to-you."

And Tobit answered and said, "What gladness still [is] for-me? I [am] a-man blind, not seeing the-light of-the heaven; in-the-darkness I-am, like the-dead who-no-longer see the-light. Living-dead I-am. Voices I-hear, but see I-do-not."

And [Raphael] said to-him, "Take-heart; near at-hand [is] the-healing before God for-you. Take-heart."

And Tobit said to-him, "My-son Tobias wishes to-go to-Media. Can you-lead him and guide him? And I-will-give you wages, brother."

And he-said to-him, "I-am-able to-go with him and the-ways I-know and with Gabael our-brother I-have-stayed-the-night, who-lives in-Rages of-Media. It-is two days' journey from Ecbatana to-Rages, for it-lies in-a-mountainous district."

**5:10** And Tobit said to-him, "Tell me, brother, what tribe and family [are] you? Tell-me."

**5:11** And he-said to-him, "What tribe do-you-seek? Or what family?"

And Tobit said, "Brother, I-am-seeking from-what tribe you-are and what your-name [is]."

**5:12** And he-said, "I am Azariah, son of-the great Ananias, from your-brethren."

**5:13** And Tobit said to-him, "Welcome you-come, brother! And do-not be-angry with-me that I-sought to-know your-tribe and your family; you-are brother to-me and from a-good and noble lineage. For I-knew Ananias and Jathan, the-sons of-the great Shemaiah, when we-went together to-Jerusalem to-worship and we-offered the-firstborn-offerings and the-tenths of-the produce, and they-were-not led-astray in-the-error of-our-brethren. You-are from a-great family, brother.

**5:14** But tell-me, what wages shall-I give you? A-drachma a-day and what-is-necessary for you just-as for my-son?

**5:15** And moreover, if you-return whole, I-will-add to-the wages."

And so they-agreed.

**5:16** And Tobit said to-Tobias, "Child, prepare yourself for-the journey and go with your-brother. And may-God who-is in-the-heaven prosper your-way and may-the-angel of-God accompany you."

And they-both went-out to-go, and the-dog of-the-young-man went-with them and came-along behind them.

**5:17** And Hannah his-mother wept and said to-Tobit, "Why have-you sent my-child away? Is-he-not the-staff of-our-hands, and does-he-not go-in and go-out before-us?

**5:18** Do-not add money to-money; let-it-be as-ransom for our-child.

**5:19** For the-life that-is-given to-us by-the-Lord, it-suffices us."

**5:20** And Tobit said to-her, "Do-not worry, sister; he-will-go-out whole and will-return whole to-us, and your-eyes will-see him.

**5:21** For a-good angel will-accompany him, and his-journey will-be-made-prosperous, and he-will-return whole."

And she-ceased weeping.

**5:22** [The final verse in Sinaiticus continues the farewell, with Hannah silent and Tobias departing with Raphael.]

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

- **5:4**: "he-found Raphael who-was an-angel; and he-did-not know [it]" — the dramatic irony is explicit in the Greek: *ouk egnō* (he-did-not-know). This is announced to the reader before Tobias has any clue.
- **5:9**: The extended dialogue at the first meeting is preserved in full per Sinaiticus (GII). The shorter recension (GI) condenses this considerably. Tobit's lament over his blindness — "Living-dead I-am" — renders Greek *nekros zon eimi*, a striking oxymoron preserved verbatim.
- **5:12**: "Azariah" means "the LORD has helped" — a deeply ironic name for a concealed angel whose help is exactly what follows.
- **5:16**: "the dog of the young man" — GII includes the dog; it appears again in 11:4. A notable narrative detail unique to the longer recension.
- **5:17–19**: Hannah's speech preserves three distinct rhetorical questions plus a theological declaration. "Staff of our hands" is a Semitism for "support of our household."
- **5:22**: GII and GI number this section differently; Sinaiticus chapter 5 ends after Hannah stops weeping. — EMET
